description: An offer to edit is an offer to make the diagnostic go away, so it is only ever made where a bridge is really the remedy. A mark that binds to nothing is fixed by rewriting it, and a `throw` the author wrote is fixed by returning the error instead — neither offers an edit.

diagnostics.message: `@nothrow` binds to nothing on `total`: a mark is a claim about a body, and the value here is not a function written at this declaration. Mark the function where its body is written, or — if that body is not yours — assert its color in `nothrow.overrides.json`.
